title: Invest the easy way
intro: One stock carries the risk of one company. This Lesson shows funds that hold many investments at once. It also shows why their fees matter.

check.prompt: The government guarantees that an ETF will not lose money.
check.explanation: Myth. ETFs are not guaranteed or insured, and you can lose money.

check.prompt: Two funds follow the same index and earn the same before fees, but one has lower fees. Which gives you more?
check.explanation: The fund with lower fees. Fees reduce your return.

check.prompt: You can buy a market index directly.
check.explanation: Myth. You cannot buy an index itself, but an index fund follows one.
